name: agency-shopify
label: Shopify Agency Partners
description: Targets decision-makers at Shopify Plus agencies, eCommerce consultancies, and digital commerce implementation firms. Pitch angle: capacity overflow for Shopify Plus builds and SuiteCommerce cross-sell for agencies looking to expand their offering.
_note: AOTT's angle with Shopify agencies is twofold: (1) overflow capacity — when their Shopify Plus pipeline backs up, we embed as the extra build team; (2) SuiteCommerce cross-sell — we bring SuiteCommerce capability they may not carry in-house. Target: decision-makers at Shopify Plus agencies, eCommerce consultancies, and digital commerce implementation firms.
_company_type_signals_note: These signals must be platform-specific to count toward agency boost. Generic words like 'Solutions', 'Services', 'Digital', 'Advisory' alone are not sufficient — they must appear alongside a platform keyword.
_target_industries_note: LinkedIn industry field alone is not sufficient — must be combined with platform-specific domain signals.
_retail_brand_guidance: A lead at a retail/DTC/consumer brand (not an agency) qualifies as warm or above ONLY when their company is a confirmed Shopify Plus or SuiteCommerce user. The platform signal must be strong and current. Without it, classify as cold regardless of seniority.
_excluded_employers_note: AOTT sells staff augmentation TO the partner ecosystem, never to the platform vendors themselves. Anyone whose CURRENT employer is a platform vendor is not a lead: they have internal delivery orgs and do not buy external agency capacity. Detect from the headline when company fields are null: '@ Shopify', 'at Shopify', 'Partnerships at Shopify', 'at Oracle', 'at Adobe', 'at BigCommerce'. Shopify's own partnerships/BD staff match this criteria's role list almost perfectly — they are NOT leads. Classify excluded-employer leads as cold and cap score at 25 regardless of seniority — this exclusion overrides company_type_signals and seniority_signals. Do not drop them from output; the operator can still manually approve a rare vendor-side contact from the cold tier. Also cold: mega-SIs with in-house delivery at scale (Accenture, Deloitte, Capgemini, IBM, Infosys, TCS, Wipro, Cognizant, Coforge) — cap at 40; and in-house digital/ecommerce leaders at end-user enterprises without a confirmed platform signal — cap at 30. The buyer must work at an agency or consultancy whose BUSINESS is delivering Shopify/commerce projects for clients, sized boutique-to-mid-market like the reference_companies.
_search_terms_note: QUERY-BUILDING RULE for Step 2: never pair a bare platform name with a role — 'Shopify' + 'Director of Partnerships' matches Shopify's own partnerships team. Every query must include an agency/partner/expert qualifier alongside the platform name (e.g. 'Shopify Plus agency', 'Shopify expert') so results skew toward people whose employer partners with the platform rather than the vendor's own staff.
